text: Apple's $349 HomePod is only the second-most expensive major smart speaker you can buy (AAPL, AMZN, MSFT, GOOGL) By Troy Wolverton Jan 26, 2018, 5:58 pm 18 pts It's hard to believe now, but little more than three years ago, smart speakers didn't exist. And little more than six years ago, you couldn't find any consumer device with a built-in voice assistant. My, how things have changed.
